- in environment variables, try a new machine install with FEEDBACK set to FALSE. Refer to BL-8947.
VM notes

Windows VM. Install MS Edge, then take a snapshot so you can return to same restore point easily. Setup several version (Windows 10, Win 7). Install Bloom. Ensure required .dotnet version is upgraded if the VM's version is inadequate.
Open/Create Collection dialog should open on same monitor where Bloom in running

links.text: Open/Create Collection dialog should open on same monitor where Bloom in running

text: Try reporting a problem with an email address with unusual characters. N.B. BL-9995 has been put on hold; ignore this issue.

This task uses some special test code in Bloom that is activated by editing one of the books in a special collection, but only if you are in a Debug build or of the environment variable BloomSandbox is set to yes. So make sure one of those is true. May not work in a release build even with BloomSandbox set.
Unzip the "Fake Error Report Collection" (See Bloom Team/Testing/Bloompacks). Open the books one by one. Verify error messages according to screenshots. [N.B. willing to live with BL-12226.]
- ensure page thumbnail dropdown is in the correct position for left and right pages. [BL-15344 scheduled for 6.4+]

Change UI language several times.  Be sure to check the "Show translations which have not been approved yet" menu item to get the maximum coverage. Ensure all strings are localised immediately. Select "Other Collections" and change the UI language there.  [N.B. willing to live with BL-12393]

- Make a derivative from a book previously made from a custom template made by some other user, e.g. various EFL books, or this book. Click Add Page. Scroll up and down several times. Close dialog and repeat. Ensure the template pages for standard Bloom book templates do not get corrupted. Ensure custom template pages are not listed.
Try various copyright and licensing options and ensure the correct CC icons display and license version etc.. Try steps in BL-11032.

Test data recovery and error reporting for "page wipe" error in BL-13123 [JohnT: not sure what this is getting at. BL-13123 does not have any instructions for getting into a situation where a "page wipe" can be reported/recovered from. It is about zoom causing loss of page content. Zoom is now very responsive and very unlikely to cause loss of data. I tried it a few times, but unless there is some other way to cause a page wipe, I think we can retire this test.]

text: Some notes on Branding and Appearance system migration can be found here. Test a couple of auto-migrations for EFL books. Test a couple of active brandings like Little Zebra and ensure they don't break.
Double-click on a book should bring you directly into Edit. See also BL-12820.
In Enterprise Settings, enter Test-727011-1339. Look around. (See testing notes for expected display)

In Enterprise Settings, enter  Sample-727011-1960. Text and images should show in 7 slots. PDF. Note, the PDF is wrong for the Title page. On 23 Feb 2022, the Sample branding was changed so that page has a single Little Zebra Books logo on the bottom of the title page.
- Ensure Outside back cover image appear on page thumbnail. N.B. we won't fix BL-9010.
Ensure you can copy a translation bubble. [N.B. we are willing to live with BL-10294.]

Download one of Look, Listen and Live books. Publish simple PDF. Compare this PDF with the PDF on Blorg and ensure they are exactly the same. Pay close attention to margins. (Note that in order to get the font to match you may need to set your collection default font to Calibri)

Set the settings:book making:special script settings to Right to Left. Export to epub and verify that things look right, including: navigation arrows work opposite direction. Note: "not addressed hiding the inapplicable button when showing the first or last page".

links.text: Note: "not addressed hiding the inapplicable button when showing the first or last page"

text: Text Languages: Ensure 1) all content languages are presented and your selection is remembered if you exit publish or switch between BloomPUB and Web Publish; 2) checkboxes are disabled and checked for any "required" languages regardless of completeness (e.g. a trilingual book will have three checked languages which are greyed out); 3) only the languages selected are uploaded (web) or embedded in saved BloomPUB; 4) tooltip says "Select this if you want readers to be able to choose to read the book in this language"; 5) if the book is bilingual or trilingual, then those languages cannot be unchecked regardless of completeness. 6) incomplete languages are correctly identified ; 7) a language which is only in xmatter is not advertised on blorg [Quick test resource: download this book in an English collection and publish. There should be English, French, Hausa, Spanish & Swahili.]
Install a new font on your computer from https://software.sil.org/fonts/. Create a book using this font and try to publish to Bloom Reader. The font should get embedded.
Bloom Enterprise feature. Test out Bulk Upload. Ensure a bookshelf is required. Try multiple uploads to different bookshelves. Ensure correct xmatter is applied, cf. BL-10347 for Kyrgyz project.
Test the "Configure & Preview" 1) with an audio book with scrolling text like these. Change Record These Pages settings and ensure these are reflected in the preview.

Test the "Configure & Preview" 2) with an audio book like with multiple languages like this one. Select a language using the language chooser and ensure the audio plays the correct language. Note: currently, all embedded languages will be available.
- Publish an audio book with scrolling text like these. Ensure preview doesn't choke. Ensure you publish to all formats : Youtube, Facebook, Feature phone, mp3.
4) Motion books (try portrait and landscape). Ensure smooth transition between pages. [Portrait books reorient to landscape when Motion Book is checked.]

Make sure that uploaded videos look correct in desktop and mobile, Facebook and YouTube. See video results spreadsheet and add new columns if you found a new problem.  Test at least A5, 16x9, portrait, landscape.

Download a Portrait accessible book like Aminata and a Landscape accessible book like Bo. Publish to ePUB and test results in preview and using eKiTabu for Windows.
Jan 2026 - I could not find any Android app which actually worked well. We used to specify using eKitabu for Android here. Even if you can find the old verison of the app which generally worked, talking books didn't work. Dolphin EasyReader played audio erratically. Lis-a talking books didn't work. Our latest research on readers is published at https://docs.bloomlibrary.org/ePUB-notes/.

- make sure the results are expected: missing image descriptions should generate WCAG 2.0 A violations, but everything else should be non-critical. (Expected: Minor, Best Practice issues "aria-allowed-role", and Moderate Best Practice "landmark-unique" rule.) And there are more violations we are "living with" in BL-11704.
Add a picture from a photograph that has been saved as a PNG. Confirm that Bloom silently converts to jpg. [fixed in 5.0]. Update: willing to live with BL-12400 for now.

Try importing images from \Bloom Team\Testing\Materials for Bloom Editor Testing\Bad Images. Expected results listed in BL-8996. Note comments in BL-10434. [The Bad Images folder no longer exists.  Consult BL-8996 and BL-10434 for details on recreating a set of bad images to test.]
Import image from https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1LdSEvkkkPMQ1G5lSEGIxnbQe45c52k7p?usp=drive_link and attempt to crop it starting from the top.

- Enable a keyman keyboard, should work, should disable longpress. Switching back to English should re-enable longpress.  Test steps in BL-4166. (This Keyman keyboard can test with  'a  which should produce  á :  keyboard   )

N.B. Turn on Performance Measuring for all tests and monitor.

There are some known Overlay rough edges. Here is the full list of open #comic issues. Note: this list was substantially rewritten for a new UI after most of the Dokimion links were added; they may be out of date.
Re-test BL-16237.
Observe thumbnails for comics. Note: BL-7916 is not an issue.
Test https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-10418.

- Character changes made to L1 change the "normal" style, which then affects L2 & L3. But if you set a character style on L2 or L3, that choice will override "normal" for that language. This should be indicated by the message at the bottom of the character tab: "This formatting is for all LANGUAGE text boxes with "XXX" style". But see https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-9965 before writing up inheritence issues.
- Text Box Hint Bubbles. Must be in book started with the Template Starter to see this tab. https://i.imgur.com/Zro3LQd.png
Make sure text-overflow is reported for all types of paragraph alignment, and all types of verticle page alignment. Note BL-10464 is a bug we'll live with. Also, this issue has not been resolved.

- An overflow condition for a Device 16x9 book (only) will show scroll bars instead of the RED text. There will be no danger triangle on the thumbnail. Try various page layouts and vertical alignments and multiple paragraphs. Try adding new paragraphs at the end. N.B. Current limitation: Device layout, vertically centered, overflowing multiple paragraphs has problems outlined in BL-12750 which has not been fixed. Also note BL-14260 is an issue we will live with.

Paste in this text: "word joiner: x⁠x zero width nonjoiner: x‌xc". With cursor in the text box, hold down CTRL+SHIFT+SPACE. Verify that you see the invisibles. More samples are at https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-12495/Improve-Show-Invisibles, but you don't need to test individual ones.
Right click on book and test all functions. Note: BL-9495 is a bug we're willing to live with. Note that Export to Word of Sample Shell books is broken as of 6.2 (see BL-15728).

- Check book name in collections tab changes to match title. (JT 6.3: previously included "Verify these new features.". But the rename command is now covered in another line below. I think we should let this line be about automatic renaming to match title.)

- Test the right-click rename function. This should rename the book's folder and .htm file, not the title of the book. Can also be started using F2. Subsequent renamings of the title should not affect the renamed folder -- it should be "locked". Right-click rename delete should restore the book back to match the title and unlock the book, i.e. renaming the title should not affect the book folder name. Ensure the position of the book thumbnail does not shift when renaming. Try renaming a book with a html5 widget (cf. BL-12598). If you make a BloomPub or other publications, the default filename should be based on the folder name, not the title. (JT 6.3: but if you made e.g. a BloomPub previously, Bloom remembers the name you used to make it, and that is the default rather than the current folder name. This is probably intentional, or at least OK, so I'm not making a bug report.)

Cover tab: Make a collection with languages English, French and German. Download one of the open bible books like this one. Make a derivative. Open Book Settings: Cover. You should see this. Try publishing with a) English only; b) English + German; c) English + French; d) English + French + German. Ensure BloomPUB preview and its output (in BloomPUB Viewer and Bloom Reader) reflect these choices. Confirm on Blorg READ. Confirm PDF. Hide Topic and confirm output in several output choices: BloomPUB preview, PDF, Web. Ensure English can not be deselected.

Auto migration: Some notes on Branding and Appearance system migration can be found here. Test a couple of auto-migrations for EFL books. Test a couple of active brandings like Little Zebra and ensure they don't break.
- Make sure it works with 0, 1, 2+ text blocks on page. Note: we won't fix this issue.
- Test with the large mature set from https://issues.bloomlibrary.org/youtrack/issue/BL-3542

- What happens if non-alphabetic characters are specified as letters? esp. # and * (cf. BL-10446). N.B. BL-10926 still not solved).
- They are allowed.
- multiple paragraphs (including with missing para-final punctuation) (living with BL-11734)
- Note: corner case of BL-9981 is deemed trivial and will not be fixed.

In Edit, add a new Quiz page
- Ensure the Quiz answer "cells" don't spill into the page number on a 16x9 Landscape or Portrait page, or a A5 page. Note: Decision in BL-9952 is we don't report overflow on Quiz pages. 
- Note also: we assume the user manages his/her text to not overflow (which is currently possible if you have multiple lines in the Question field). 
- A future improvement might allow scrolling,  We just haven't got around to it (JH).
In "Advanced", test "import", "show in folder", and "delete". Note: "import" shows on all pages regardless of whether or not there is a video container -- BL-10459 is a bug we'll live with.

Test with a super bible book from here. After closing the error message box, try to proceed with saving the book anyhow, over WiFi, over USB cable, etc. to ensure all publishing paths are truly closed.
Download https://bloomlibrary.org/chetana/book/IwqAGQAkVI . Export it to spreadsheet. Import it into a new blank book.

Something to test "Page Type"
Note: from the Bloom docs, "Typically, the spreadsheet will be imported back into the original book or into a duplicate of the original. In this way, the original structure of each page will be maintained. You can also into a spreadsheet into a new blank book. In this case, however, the original page structure will not be maintained. "
Try resizing Bloom smaller and make sure the program responds well -- that things shift appropriately, scroll bars appear etc. N.B. Won't Fix: BL-9056, BL-9060, BL-9061.
- Check a few areas of UI when switched to another language. See BL-10430 and BL-12413 and BL-15178; there may be some areas we have decided not to fix yet.
Look at the html of a saved book. There should be no mention of "ckeditor" or other user interface leftovers. Note: ignore BL-9992.
- lots of big pictures (e.g. this book). Navigate through various parts of book.

Run tests described in BL-12756 and note performance compared to previous version. Current performance tests are for book selection, book creation, duplicate page. [Work scheduled for 6.2 -- ignore until 6.2]
